summary: This joint resolution nullifies the Bureau of Land Management's April 2022 Record of Decision on the National Petroleum Reserve in Alaska by invoking the Congressional Review Act to declare the rule has no force or effect.

scores.thoughts: The bill is a Congressional Review Act resolution disapproving a BLM land management rule. It contains no provisions related to federal spending, appropriations, or budgets.
The bill does not address taxes, tax policy, or revenue measures of any kind.
No connection to healthcare policy, insurance, or medical services.
The legislation has no bearing on firearms, gun regulations, or Second Amendment issues.
No provisions related to immigration, border policy, or citizenship.
The bill does not mention or affect reproductive rights or abortion access.
No relation to military funding, defense policy, or national security spending.

The bill uses the CRA to nullify a 2022 BLM Record of Decision governing activity in the National Petroleum Reserve-Alaska. Overturning this land-use plan removes restrictions on oil and gas development in a sensitive Arctic area, directly limiting environmental protections in favor of expanded fossil fuel extraction.
